description: This file implements an audio resampler class using the SoX ResampleStream library, designed for high-quality, real-time audio sample rate conversion for mono 16-bit PCM audio streams.

classes.name: SOXRStreamAudioResampler
classes.description: A class that performs high-quality audio resampling using the SoX ResampleStream library, optimized for mono audio streams and streaming scenarios.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the resampler object, setting internal state variables.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up the SoX ResampleStream with specified input and output sample rates.

methods.name: _maybe_clear_internal_state
methods.description: Clears the internal resampling state if a certain time has elapsed since last resampling.

methods.name: _maybe_initialize_sox_stream
methods.description: Initializes or resets the SoX resampling stream if needed, ensuring sample rates match.

methods.name: resample
methods.description: Performs resampling of input audio bytes from in_rate to out_rate using the SoX ResampleStream library.
